<a id="kind-resourceanchor"></a>
## ResourceAnchor

ResourceAnchor is the Schema for the resourceanchors API.

- `Plural`: `resourceanchors`
- `Scope`: `Namespaced`
- `APIVersion`: `multicloud.oracle.com/v1beta1`
- `Sample`: [Sample](../../../samples/multicloud/v1beta1/resourceanchor.md) (`config/samples/multicloud_v1beta1_resourceanchor.yaml`)
- `Packages`: Not currently exposed by a customer-visible package.

<a id="kind-resourceanchor-spec"></a>
### Spec

ResourceAnchorSpec defines the desired state of ResourceAnchor.

No documented fields in the checked-in CRD schema.
